summary: Learn Quality 4.0 and digital quality management with dashboards, CAPA, FMEA, and ISO 9001:2015-aligned practice.
lede: Quality 4.0 and Digital Quality Management connects quality data, process control, and governance so professionals can measure performance, analyze defects, prioritize risks, and manage corrective actions with greater discipline. Grounded in ISO 9001:2015, Lean Six Sigma, and FMEA, the course addresses practical challenges such as nonconformance trends, supplier escapes, delayed corrective actions, and fragmented quality records. You will practice building KPI dashboards in Excel or Power BI, mapping SIPOC workflows, structuring CAPA records, reading variation with SPC charts, and turning audit findings into management review materials. The training also introduces EQMS automation, IoT-enabled inspection, and computer vision while focusing on practical use in environments where budgets are tight, systems are partly manual, and quality information is spread across spreadsheets, logs, and departmental handoffs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with quality systems and need to move from manual control to digital quality management. It suits operational practitioners, technical specialists, and leaders who must translate quality data into action. Quality Managers who oversee KPI control, audit readiness, and CAPA discipline. Quality Engineers who analyze defects, variation, and process capability. Continuous Improvement Specialists who lead Lean Six Sigma problem solving. Operations Supervisors who manage quality checks and escalation paths. Manufacturing Process Engineers who redesign controls and inspection points. Supplier Quality Engineers who track incoming defects and vendor corrective actions. Internal Auditors who assess traceability and ISO 9001 evidence packs. Compliance Managers who coordinate quality governance and document control. Production Managers who balance throughput, rework, and quality performance. Digital Transformation Leads who support EQMS and dashboard adoption.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop and be prepared to work with sample quality data, templates, and dashboard exercises. Access to Excel or Power BI is recommended, while other digital tools such as EQMS platforms may be discussed at conceptual level depending on organizational maturity.
